title: Spectral indices — formula engine
description: Reuses analysis/data/formula.py's AST whitelist validator via its additive extra_allowed_funcs parameter (REFLECTANCE, DEPTH) instead of duplicating the security-critical logic — see analysis/spectrometry/spectral_formula.py. DEPTH(feature_name) raises if that feature hasn't been extracted yet for the spectrum (enforces extract-before-index ordering). A spectral index is NEVER a definitive mineral ID — see spectrometry.interpretation.v1.json for how minerals are actually assigned.

errors.invalid_formula: Rejected/adversarial formulas raise a hard JSON-RPC error (same convention as data.preview_formula in the DATA module) — NOT a soft available:false response, since a FormulaError is a validation failure, not a legitimate empty state.

request.formula: string? (required if no index_name / overrides preset)

response.results: [{index_id, spectrum_id, sample_id, index_name, formula, result, unit, reference, quality_indicator, calc_date}]
